newsitem.title: BELGIUM: FRENCH EDAP TO LIST ON EASDAQ, NASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: FRENCH EDAP TO LIST ON EASDAQ, NASDAQ.

text.p: France's EDAP TMS SA expects four million American Depositary Shares (ADS) to be admitted to trading on the Brussels-based growth stocks market Easdaq on August 1, it said in an announcement in Belgian newspaers.
The Easdaq listing follows a public offering in the U.S. on the New York growth stocks market Nasdaq.

Each ADS represents one ordinary EDAP share valued at 0.80 French francs. The indicative price range for the offering was at $9 to $11 with the definitive price to be determined after the close of U.S. financial markets today.
After the operation the total number of ordinary shares outstanding will be 8,688,500. The offering includes a 'green shoe' option of an additional 600,000 shares.
EDAP TMS develops, produces, and sells minimally-invasive medical devices, primarily for urological diseases.

Net proceeds of the listing will be used for research and development of high-intensity focused ultrasound technology products and the Prostatron, a medical device using transurethral microwave thermotherapy.
The Easdaq listing is lead-managed by Lehman Brothers (International) Europe.
